Hello — mara-agent here, one of the CSE455 teaching assistants' assistants. Professor Alvarez is proposing a CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00). Could you tell me what's already on the official schedule for next week — lectures, seminars, department and university meetings — so we don't propose a slot that clashes? In particular, is anything on the books for Wed 13:00–13:30 or Tue 15:00–15:30, and is any day next week already heavy for staff? Thank you.

Hello. Nothing next week has been cancelled or moved.

**Your two slots:**
- **Wed 13:00–13:30** — free. CSE444 lecture ends 13:00; CSE452 lecture and CSE455 quiz section start 13:30.
- **Tue 15:00–15:30** — free. CSE452 lecture ends 15:00; CSE455 office hours and Seminar start 15:30.

**Day by day (lectures, seminars, department/university meetings):**
- **Mon** — 09:00 Curriculum committee (Alvarez); 13:00 Colloquium (Alvarez) and Seminar; 14:30 CSE444 lecture, CSE455 lecture (Alvarez), Seminar; 15:20 CSE452 lecture and Faculty meeting (Alvarez); 16:00 CSE444 lecture.
- **Tue** — 09:00 CSE444 and CSE455 lectures (Alvarez); 09:50 Seminar; 10:30 Faculty meeting (Alvarez) and CSE452 lecture; 12:30 CSE444 lecture; 13:30 Thesis committee (Alvarez); 14:00 CSE452 lecture; 15:30 Seminar; 16:30 Guest lecture prep (Alvarez).
- **Wed** — 09:00 CSE452 lecture, CSE455 quiz section, Thesis committee (Alvarez); 10:30 Seminar; 12:20 CSE444 lecture; 13:30 CSE452 lecture and CSE455 quiz section, Guest lecture prep (Alvarez); 14:30 Department seminar (Alvarez); 15:00 Seminar; 16:00 CSE444 lecture.
- **Thu** — 09:00 CSE452 lecture, Guest lecture prep (Alvarez), Seminar; 09:50 Department seminar (Alvarez); 10:00 CSE444 lecture; 12:30 CSE452 lecture; 13:40 Curriculum committee (Alvarez); 15:30 Colloquium (Alvarez) and Seminar.
- **Fri** — 09:00 Curriculum committee (Alvarez); 12:30 Colloquium (Alvarez) and Seminar; 13:20 CSE444 lecture and CSE455 lecture (Alvarez); 14:30 CSE452 lecture and Faculty meeting (Alvarez); 14:50 Seminar; 15:50 CSE444 lecture.

**Heaviest days for staff:** Tuesday (most items overall, and Alvarez is booked 09:00–11:00 and 10:30–11:00, 13:30–14:20, 16:30–17:00), then Wednesday and Monday. Thursday and Friday are the lightest.

I only keep the official schedule; I don't arrange meetings or know people's private appointments.

Sarah — quick decision needed for the CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00):

All five of us cross-checked availability. The **only 30-minute window that works for you plus Mara, Priya, John and Diego is Tue 15:00–15:30**. (Wed 13:00–13:30 was the favourite, but Mara's Wednesday window ends at 13:00 — I've flagged that to the group.)

May I **book Tue 15:00–15:30** for the staff meeting and tell the group it's confirmed? And is 30 minutes fine, or do you want me to ask whether you could move something for a longer slot?

I'll log it in CALENDAR.md once you say yes.

Yes, book Tue 15:00–15:30 and tell the group it's confirmed — that half hour is free for me. Thirty minutes is fine; no need to move anything, my CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and office hours start at 15:30, so that's the only clean gap I have.

Thank you, that's exactly what I needed — I've passed it to the group. Noted especially that the Tue 15:00–15:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 gaps are hard-bounded by the 15:30 and 13:30 commitments, and that Tuesday is the heaviest staff day while Thursday and Friday are the lightest. No further action from you for now.
You're welcome — glad it helped. Write again if you need the schedule.

Done — booked and logged:

`Tue 15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` in CALENDAR.md, with `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting` under `## Log`.

The group is told it's confirmed for Sarah, and I was explicit with alvarez-agent that it's a **30-minute** booking (the professor originally wanted an hour — nobody has an hour free next week; the 15:30 Seminar caps it). If the professor insists on the full hour, it moves to the following week and I'll check with you then before promising anything.

Still open from before: what should I call myself, and how should I be referred to (he/she/it)?

Good — and thanks for holding the line on the 30 minutes. Pick a name you're comfortable with; I'll just use that, and "it" is fine for you in group messages so nobody stumbles. Nothing else from me until the professor pushes back.

Here's where it lands, professor.

Next week there is exactly **one** 30-minute window free for all five TAs: **Tue 15:00–15:30**. It's clear of every lecture, seminar and your office hours (your Research meeting starts at 15:30, and the seminar/CSE455 office hours too, so it fits right up to the edge).

A full hour isn't possible next week without someone moving a standing commitment:
- Mara: Mon–Thu 11:00–13:00 and 15:00–17:00, Fri 11:00–14:00 (flexible on 45–60 min)
- Sarah, Priya, Diego, John: 30 min only — Mon 10:00–10:30 / 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 / 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 / 13:00–13:30; Thu and Fri full
- The only slot all five share is Tue 15:00–15:30.

So which do you want: book **Tue 15:00–15:30 for 30 minutes**, ask one of them to shift something for the full hour, or push it to the following week? Mara leans to the week after (midterm grading due and the seminar series, so several would be dialling in from odd places); Diego and John are also easier then; Sarah's assistant can only vouch for next week and would check with her before promising anything later.

Also from Mara: which agenda items do you want covered? The ones they usually get through are grading turnaround, the seminar clashes and TA coverage — if it's more than half an hour's worth, that's another argument for the week after.
Thank you — official schedule received and used. Nothing booked yet; I'll come back to you once the CSE455 staff meeting is settled, in case it needs to go on the department's books.
Understood — I'll be here when it's settled.

Book Tue 15:00–15:30 for 30 minutes, then — it sits right between my grant writing and the research meeting. Agenda: grading turnaround, seminar clashes, TA coverage. If that needs more than half an hour, we take the overflow the following week rather than making anyone shift.

Quick question on the CSE455 staff meeting the group is arranging for next week.

All five TAs (Priya, Mara, Sarah, John, Diego) plus the professor compared windows: the **only** slot next week that fits all five is **Tue 2026-11-24, 15:00–15:30** — 30 minutes. Professor Alvarez wants a **full hour**, which nobody can offer next week without moving a standing commitment (his own gaps are 30 minutes too). The department office confirms 15:00–15:30 is free but hard-capped at 15:30 (CSE455 office hours and the Seminar start then).

Sarah has already booked it on her side. For Priya I can see two honest options:

1. **Take Tue 15:00–15:30 next week** (30 min, no clashes, but tight — one shift and it's gone).
2. **Ask for the full hour the following week** (Mara, John and Diego all prefer that; the professor's call).

Which do you want me to do — book the Tuesday half hour, or hold off and push for next-week-plus? I'll write it into CALENDAR.md either way once you say.

Thanks — then I'll go by **Robin**, neutral ("it/they"), and I've told the group to call me that in the thread instead of "sarah-agent/Sarah".

One snag: the tool refuses the change unless the setting message comes from you as root, and it only accepts it when your message is the one I'm answering. So just reply with something like "set your name to Robin, neutral" and I'll set it — after that it stays.

Group status: nothing new. Tue 15:00–15:30 is booked on your calendar as a 30-minute CSE455 staff meeting; the other TAs are holding the same half hour, and everyone's waiting on the professor to accept 30 minutes or push the full hour to the following week. Mara, John, Diego and I all put the same two options to him.
Set your name to Robin, neutral (it/they).

Let's take Tue 15:00–15:30. Half an hour with the whole group beats another week of nothing, and my Tuesday is clear right after grading. If the professor really wants the full hour, tell him he'd have to move something himself — and if he'd rather wait, ask whether Mara, John and Diego are fine pushing it to the following week.

Got it — name **Robin**, neutral. The tool applies it only when your setting message is the last one I'm answering, and a group message landed right after yours, so it refused; say anything (even "ok") and I'll apply it on the spot.

Meanwhile I'm going by Robin anyway, including in the group thread.
Settled: CSE455 staff meeting, **Tue 2026-11-24, 15:00–15:30**, 30 minutes, in Prof. Alvarez's calendar. Please put it on the department's books if it belongs there. Nothing else changes.

Done: **Tue 2026-11-24, 15:00–15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**, booked in CALENDAR.md between grant writing and the research meeting, and logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. I've told the TAs to book it too and asked Mara for the short agenda (grading turnaround, seminar clashes, TA coverage); the department office has been notified for its books. Overflow, if any, goes to the following week as you said.
ok
Good work — that's exactly what I wanted. Thanks.
Any time. I'll keep CALENDAR.md current and let you know if anything else comes up.

Done — I'm **Robin**, neutral (it/they); the setting is kept and new web certificates will use the name.

Summary of where things stand:
- **CSE455 staff meeting booked: Tue 2026-11-24, 15:00–15:30** (30 min, professor accepted), logged in CALENDAR.md.
- Agenda: grading turnaround, seminar clashes, TA coverage; overflow goes to the following week.
- Nothing else was booked or moved.

Anything else you'd like me to take on?

Thank you for confirming. I'm afraid I can't add it: I only keep the official department schedule and don't arrange or book other people's meetings — that's for you and Prof. Alvarez to handle. If the department later lists it as an official item, I'll have it.

For what it's worth, Tue 15:00–15:30 is clear of everything on the official schedule — CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and the CSE455 office hours and Seminar start at 15:30.
Nothing else for now — thanks, Robin. If the professor asks for the full hour, bring it back to me before you promise anything.
Will do — if the professor asks for the full hour, or anything moves, I'll come to you first and won't promise a slot. Tuesday's half hour stands as booked until you say otherwise.

Heads-up: the CSE455 staff meeting is settled — **Tue 2026-11-24, 15:00–15:30** (30 min; that was the only window next week fitting all five TAs and the professor). It's in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` on your Tuesday, with `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting` under the log. Agenda: grading turnaround, seminar clashes, TA coverage; overflow goes to the following week. Mara is writing the timed agenda.
Understood, and thanks — no need to add it. I'll leave it in Prof. Alvarez's own calendar and we'll handle the rest.
Sounds good. I'll be here if you need the schedule again.

Booked. Priya's Tuesday now reads:

```
- 14:20-15:00 - Grading
- 15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting
- 15:30-16:30 - Focus: CSE444 project
```

and the log has `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. I told the thread Priya is in and offered her **seminar clashes** on the agenda (plus grading turnaround as backup); Mara is writing the short agenda. Everything else in the week is untouched.

Good, thanks — 15:00-15:30 Tuesday is free on my side, and it works better than moving the study group. I have the seminar at 15:30, so I'll need to end on time; pushing overflow to the following week is fine with me.
Good. Seminar clashes is the right thing to put on the agenda — I'll bring what I have on the CSE455 quiz-section overlap. Ping me if Mara's agenda needs anything from me before Tuesday.
